summary: New admin no longer waits, and RFA works for every admin by default.

new.title: RFA approval by the department by default
new.text: With the RFA portal on, a disabled admin can ask to be enabled without any setting, and an owner of the admin's department approves. Off or Auto can still be chosen.

new.title: RFA settings in Admin accounts and Departments
new.text: The RFA mode, the address the PIN is sent to and the hours an admin may ask for are now set in the Manager. A department with no owner is flagged.

fixes.title: New admin no longer waits for a lookup
fixes.text: Add to pending changes now stages a new admin at once. PIM checks the name when the change is applied, and never creates over or changes an existing account that PIM did not create.
